TabsRoot.description: Holds the selected value and shares it with the parts inside it.

props.value: The selected tab's value. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the tabs.
props.defaultValue: The tab selected at first, when the tabs aren't controlled. Without it, or when it names no tab, the first enabled tab is selected.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new value when a tab is selected.
props.orientation: Which arrow keys move between tabs: Left and Right for `horizontal`, Up and Down for `vertical`.

dataAttributes.data-activation-direction: Which way the selection last moved: `left` or `right` when horizontal, `up` or `down` when vertical, and `none` until it first moves.

TabsList.description: The `tablist` that holds the tabs. It is one Tab stop, which lands on the selected tab; the arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs.

props.activateOnFocus: Whether a tab is selected as soon as the arrow keys focus it. With `false`, the focused tab is selected with Enter or Space.
props.loopFocus: Whether the arrow keys wrap around from the last tab to the first and back.

dataAttributes.data-activation-direction: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

TabsTab.description: A button that selects its panel. It carries `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, and `aria-controls` pointing at its panel while selected.

props.value: The value that names this tab and the panel it selects.
props.disabled: Whether the tab can't be selected. It stays in the list with `aria-disabled`, is skipped by the arrow keys, and your own click and key handlers on it don't run.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the tab is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-activation-direction: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

TabsPanel.description: The content shown while its tab is selected, with `role="tabpanel"`, labelled by its tab. It is mounted while selected and stays mounted while it animates out.

props.value: The value of the tab that shows this panel.
props.keepMounted: Whether the panel stays in the document, with `hidden`, while its tab isn't selected.

dataAttributes.data-hidden: Present while the panel is kept mounted but its tab isn't selected.
dataAttributes.data-starting-style: Present for the first frame after the panel appears: style the state it animates in from.
dataAttributes.data-ending-style: Present while the panel animates out. It is removed when its transitions and animations finish.
dataAttributes.data-activation-direction: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

TabsIndicator.description: An element that follows the selected tab. Place it inside TabsList and position it with its CSS variables. It is hidden until the selected tab has a size, and absent while no tab is selected.

dataAttributes.data-activation-direction: Which way the selection last moved: `left`, `right`, `up`, `down`, or `none` until it first moves.

cssVariables.--active-tab-left: The selected tab's distance from the list's left padding edge, in px, including the list's scroll.
cssVariables.--active-tab-right: The distance from the selected tab's right edge to the end of the list's scrollable width, in px.
cssVariables.--active-tab-top: The selected tab's distance from the list's top padding edge, in px, including the list's scroll.
cssVariables.--active-tab-bottom: The distance from the selected tab's bottom edge to the end of the list's scrollable height, in px.
cssVariables.--active-tab-width: The selected tab's width, in px.
cssVariables.--active-tab-height: The selected tab's height, in px.
